title: Welcome, O life, I go to encounter for the millionth time the reality of experience
html_source: Here, Stephen is signifying that he’s ready to leave his home and pursue his dream of becoming an artist. Stephen thinks that by leaving, he will be able to truly get “the reality of experience” by using his individuality and no longer be controlled by the church, nation and his family.
